name: Snake
description: Grow a snake by eating fruit without hitting a wall or your own tail.
objective: Reach the target length.
howTo: Steer one grid square at a time. Eat fruit to grow, but never reverse directly into your own body.

name: Brick Breaker
description: Bounce a ball from a paddle and clear a wall of bricks.
objective: Break every brick before losing all balls.
howTo: Move the paddle under the ball. Paddle contact changes the bounce angle; stronger bricks need more than one hit.

name: Pong Duel
description: Two-player paddle tennis with first-to-five scoring.
objective: Score five points before the other player.
howTo: Each player moves one paddle. Return the ball past the opponent’s paddle to score.

name: Space Invaders
description: Defend the ground from a marching alien formation.
objective: Destroy every invader before they land.
howTo: Move the ship beneath the formation and fire upward. Dodge enemy shots and stop the aliens from reaching your row.

name: Asteroid Patrol
description: Rotate, thrust, and shoot in wraparound space.
controls: Left/Right rotate • Up thrust • Space fire
objective: Clear the asteroid field.
howTo: Rotate the ship, thrust in the facing direction, and fire. The ship and rocks wrap around screen edges.

name: Flappy Flight
description: Use short flaps to fly through pipe gaps.
objective: Pass the required number of gaps.
howTo: Tap or press Space to flap upward. Gravity pulls the bird down between flaps.

name: Dino Dash
description: Run across a desert course by jumping and ducking.
objective: Reach the finish marker.
howTo: Jump over cacti and duck under flying obstacles. Timing changes as the level gets faster.

name: Crossy Street
description: Cross traffic lanes and rivers one step at a time.
objective: Reach the far side safely.
howTo: Move one tile per press. Avoid cars; on river lanes, stand on moving logs instead of water.

name: Maze Chase
description: Collect pellets in a maze while ghosts pursue you.
objective: Clear all pellets.
howTo: Move through corridors, collect every pellet, and use power pellets to temporarily weaken ghosts.

name: Falling Blocks
description: Rotate tetrominoes and complete horizontal lines.
controls: Arrows • Up rotate • Space hard drop
objective: Clear the target number of lines.
howTo: Move and rotate the falling piece. A completely filled row disappears and scores a line.

name: Number Merge 2048
description: Slide equal number tiles together to make larger values.
objective: Create the level’s target tile.
howTo: Every move slides all tiles. Equal neighboring values merge once per move, and a new tile appears afterward.

name: Memory Match
description: Find matching pairs by remembering hidden cards.
objective: Match every pair.
howTo: Turn over two cards. Matching symbols stay visible; mismatches flip back after a short delay.

name: Lights Out
description: Toggle a light and its neighbors until the board is dark.
objective: Turn off every light.
howTo: Tapping one cell flips that cell plus its up, down, left, and right neighbors.

name: Minesweeper
description: Use number clues to reveal every safe square.
controls: Tap reveal • A/B toggle flag mode
objective: Reveal all non-mine cells.
howTo: Numbers show how many mines touch a square. Switch to flag mode to mark suspected mines.

name: Mini Sudoku
description: Complete a compact Sudoku grid with valid rows, columns, and regions.
objective: Fill every blank correctly.
howTo: Select a blank and choose a number. No value may repeat in a row, column, or bold region.

name: Tic-Tac-Toe
description: Classic three-in-a-row against an expert minimax bot or a second local player.
objective: Make three marks in a row. The single-player bot uses perfect-play strategy.
howTo: Place X in an empty square. The computer responds with O; rows, columns, and diagonals count.

name: Connect Four
description: Drop discs into columns and connect four.
objective: Connect four before the computer.
howTo: Choose a column; the disc falls to its lowest open space. Four can be horizontal, vertical, or diagonal.

name: Reversi
description: Bracket opposing discs to flip them.
objective: Finish with more discs than the computer.
howTo: Place a disc so one or more straight lines of enemy discs are trapped between your new disc and an existing one.

name: Checkers
description: Move diagonally, jump captures, and crown kings.
objective: Capture all computer pieces.
howTo: Select one of your pieces and a legal diagonal destination. Jump over enemy pieces to capture; reaching the far row crowns a king.

name: Battleship
description: Search a hidden ocean grid for an enemy fleet.
objective: Sink every ship within the shot limit.
howTo: Fire at unexplored coordinates. Hits are marked differently from misses; use hit patterns to locate each ship.

name: Simon Says
description: Watch and repeat an expanding color sequence.
objective: Repeat the full target sequence.
howTo: Watch the flashing pattern without pressing. When it stops, enter the colors in the same order.

name: Whack-a-Mole
description: Hit real targets quickly and avoid decoys.
objective: Reach the target score before time expires.
howTo: Tap the brown moles when they appear. Red decoys subtract points.

name: Bubble Shooter
description: Shoot colored bubbles into matching clusters.
objective: Clear the required number of bubbles.
howTo: Aim from the launcher. A connected group of at least three matching colors pops.

name: Basketball Shot
description: Drag to choose a basketball shot arc.
objective: Score the required baskets within the shot limit.
howTo: Pull away from the ball to set direction and power, then release. The ball follows a gravity arc.

name: Archery Range
description: Draw a bow and compensate for wind.
objective: Earn the required target score.
howTo: Pull back from the bow, aim, and release. Rings score differently and wind bends the arrow’s path.

name: Mini Golf
description: Putt around walls and into the hole.
objective: Sink the ball near or under par.
howTo: Drag away from the ball to set a shot. Bank off boundaries and avoid obstacles.

name: Road Racer
description: Steer through traffic and collect fuel.
objective: Reach the finish with fuel remaining.
howTo: Change lanes to avoid cars. Collect yellow fuel cans before the tank empties.

name: Soccer Showdown
description: Arcade soccer against a computer opponent or a second local player.
controls: P1 arrows + Space • P2 WASD + F
objective: Score three goals before the opponent.
howTo: Move, bump the ball, and kick near it. Choose Single Player for a computer opponent or Two Player for local play.

name: Drawing Studio
description: Free drawing with colors, brushes, undo, and clear.
controls: Pointer draw • A color • B clear
objective: Create a drawing and fill the creativity meter.
howTo: Drag on the canvas to paint. Change color and brush size, undo recent strokes, or clear the canvas.

name: Trivia Quest
description: Answer questions from several subjects.
objective: Answer enough questions correctly.
howTo: Read each question and select one of four choices. A round ends after six questions.

name: Tower Defense
description: Place and upgrade towers along a fixed enemy route.
objective: Stop every wave before the base reaches zero health.
howTo: Spend money on empty tower pads. Select an existing tower and upgrade it for more range and damage.

name: Platform Adventure
description: Run, jump, collect gems, and reach an exit.
objective: Collect every gem and touch the exit.
howTo: Move across platforms and time jumps. The exit activates only after all gems are collected.

name: Sokoban
description: Push warehouse crates onto marked goals.
objective: Place every crate on a goal.
howTo: Walk into a crate to push it one square. Crates cannot be pulled, so avoid trapping them against walls.

name: Hangman
description: Guess letters before the drawing is completed.
objective: Reveal the hidden word with fewer than six mistakes.
howTo: Choose letters one at a time. Correct guesses reveal every matching position; incorrect guesses add to the figure.

name: Blackjack
description: Draw cards and try to beat the dealer without exceeding 21.
objective: Finish closer to 21 than the dealer.
howTo: Hit to take another card or stand to end your turn. Aces count as 1 or 11 automatically.

name: Fruit Merge
description: Drop matching fruit so equal sizes combine into larger fruit.
objective: Create the target fruit size.
howTo: Position the drop line and release fruit. Two touching fruit of the same size merge into the next size.

name: Chess Tactics
description: Solve one-move chess capture and checkmate puzzles.
objective: Find the highlighted tactical move.
howTo: Select the white piece, then choose a legal square. Capture the marked king or tactical target in the allowed move count.

name: Word Search
description: Find hidden words in a letter grid.
controls: Drag from first to last letter
objective: Find every listed word.
howTo: Drag a straight horizontal, vertical, or diagonal line through the letters of a listed word.

name: Crossword Mini
description: Fill a compact crossword from across and down clues.
controls: Tap cell • keyboard or on-screen letters
objective: Complete every answer.
howTo: Select a white square and enter letters. Tap a clue to switch direction; black squares are blocked.

name: Word Scramble
description: Rearrange mixed letters into the shown clue word.
objective: Unscramble the required words.
howTo: Tap letter tiles in the correct order. Undo the last tile or shuffle the tray when stuck.

name: Math Sprint
description: Solve rapid arithmetic multiple-choice questions.
objective: Reach the correct-answer target before time runs out.
howTo: Solve the expression and select one of four answers. Correct answers add time and score; mistakes remove time.

name: Typing Race
description: Type displayed words accurately to move a racer.
objective: Finish the text course before the rival.
howTo: Enter the highlighted word exactly. Correct letters advance your racer; mistakes slow progress.

name: Rhythm Tap
description: Hit notes as they cross four timing lines.
controls: D F J K / touch lanes
objective: Complete the song with enough accurate hits.
howTo: Tap the matching lane when a falling note reaches the target line. Early, late, and missed notes affect accuracy.

name: Music Sequencer
description: Build a beat by toggling notes on a step grid.
objective: Reproduce the displayed target rhythm.
howTo: Each row is a sound and each column is a beat. Toggle cells, play the loop, and match the target pattern.

name: Paint by Numbers
description: Color numbered regions with the matching palette color.
objective: Color every region correctly.
howTo: Choose a numbered color, then tap all cells carrying that number. Incorrect colors are rejected.

name: Jigsaw Puzzle
description: Drag puzzle pieces into their matching picture positions.
objective: Place every piece correctly.
howTo: Drag loose pieces from the tray onto the board. Pieces snap only into their matching location.

name: Sliding Puzzle
description: Slide numbered tiles into order using one empty space.
objective: Arrange the numbers in ascending order.
howTo: Only a tile touching the empty square can move. Plan moves to restore the ordered grid.

name: Pipe Connect
description: Rotate pipe tiles to make one continuous water route.
objective: Connect the source to the drain with no leaks.
howTo: Tap a tile to rotate it 90 degrees. Every pipe opening must connect to a neighboring pipe or endpoint.

name: Laser Mirrors
description: Rotate mirrors so a laser reaches every target.
objective: Guide the beam to the target.
howTo: The beam travels straight and reflects from / and \ mirrors. Rotate mirrors until the beam hits the receiver.

name: Tangram Builder
description: Arrange geometric pieces inside a target silhouette.
objective: Fill the silhouette with every piece.
howTo: Drag each colored shape into its outlined target area and rotate it when necessary.

name: Nonogram
description: Use row and column clues to reveal a pixel picture.
objective: Match every clue exactly.
howTo: Numbers describe consecutive filled runs in each row and column. Mark cells filled or definitely empty.

name: Mastermind
description: Guess a hidden color sequence using exact and partial clues.
objective: Crack the code within the allowed guesses.
howTo: Build a four-color guess. Black pegs mean correct color and position; white pegs mean correct color in a different position.

name: Code Breaker
description: Deduce a three-digit lock code from arithmetic clues.
objective: Open the lock within the attempt limit.
howTo: Adjust each digit, then submit. Clues report digit sum, parity pattern, and how many digits are in the correct position.

name: Yahtzee
description: Roll five dice, hold favorites, and score categories.
controls: Tap dice to hold • A roll • B score
objective: Reach the target score in five rounds.
howTo: Roll up to three times. Hold dice between rolls, then choose the best available scoring category.

name: Mini Solitaire
description: Build four foundations upward while organizing tableau cards.
objective: Move every card to the foundations.
howTo: Build tableau columns downward in alternating colors. Move aces to foundations and continue each suit upward.

name: War Card Battle
description: Reveal cards simultaneously; the higher card wins the round.
objective: Win more rounds than the computer.
howTo: Reveal one card from each deck. Higher rank takes the point; tied cards trigger a war bonus round.

name: Go Fish
description: Collect four-card books by requesting ranks from an opponent.
objective: Finish with more books than the computer.
howTo: Ask for a rank already in your hand. If the opponent lacks it, draw from the pond; four matching ranks form a book.

name: Dice Race
description: Race tokens around a board using dice rolls and route choices.
objective: Get both tokens to the finish first.
howTo: Roll the die, choose which token to move, and use shortcut or safety spaces strategically.

name: Dots and Boxes
description: Claim boxes against a computer opponent or a second local player.
objective: Claim more boxes than the opponent.
howTo: Select two neighboring dots to draw an edge. Completing a box scores it and gives another turn.

name: Mancala
description: Sow stones around pits and capture into your store.
objective: Finish with more stones in your store.
howTo: Select a nonempty pit on your side. Stones are dropped one by one counterclockwise, skipping the opponent’s store.

name: Nine Men’s Morris
description: Form mills, remove enemy pieces, and reduce the opponent to two.
objective: Reduce the computer to two pieces or block all moves.
howTo: Place nine pieces, then move along board lines. Forming three in a row lets you remove one opposing piece.

name: Gomoku
description: Place stones and make an unbroken line of five.
objective: Make five in a row before the computer.
howTo: Players alternate placing one stone on the grid. Five horizontal, vertical, or diagonal stones wins.

name: Hex Bridge
description: Connect your two opposite board edges with a chain of stones.
objective: Connect left to right before the computer connects top to bottom.
howTo: Place one stone each turn. Neighboring hexes connect in six directions, and chains cannot be tied.

name: Domino Chain
description: Play matching dominoes onto either end of a chain.
objective: Empty your hand before the computer.
howTo: A tile is legal when one side matches an open end. Choose left or right when both ends are possible.

name: Volleyball Rally
description: Two-player side-view volleyball with jumping and spikes.
objective: Score seven points first.
howTo: Move and jump on your half. Contact sends the ball over the net; the ball may bounce once before a point is scored.

name: Air Hockey
description: Two-player table hockey with direct paddle movement.
objective: Score five goals first.
howTo: Move each mallet within its half and strike the puck into the opposite goal.

name: Bowling Challenge
description: Aim, set power, and roll a ball through ten pins.
controls: Left/Right aim • A set power • B roll
objective: Reach the target score in five frames.
howTo: Choose lane angle, stop the power meter, then roll. Pins knocked across two balls determine each frame score.

name: Fishing Lake
description: Cast, wait for a bite, then reel without snapping the line.
objective: Catch the required total weight.
howTo: Cast into the lake. When a fish bites, reel while keeping the tension needle inside the safe zone.

name: Cooking Rush
description: Prepare restaurant orders in the correct ingredient sequence.
objective: Serve the required number of correct orders.
howTo: Read the ticket, tap ingredients in order, then serve. Incorrect ingredients waste the dish and time.

name: Farm Planner
description: Plant, water, and harvest crops while managing coins and days.
objective: Reach the harvest-value target.
howTo: Cycle between seed, water, and harvest tools. Crops need watering and time before they can be sold.

name: Pet Care
description: Balance a pet’s hunger, happiness, cleanliness, and energy.
objective: Keep every need healthy through the day.
howTo: Choose feed, play, wash, or sleep. Each action helps one need but advances time and can affect others.

name: City Builder
description: Zone a small city and balance homes, jobs, power, and budget.
objective: Reach the population target without debt or power shortage.
howTo: Select residential, commercial, industrial, park, or power zoning, then place it on the grid. Compatible zones increase growth.

name: Mini Pinball
description: Keep a ball in play with flippers and hit scoring targets.
objective: Reach the target score before losing three balls.
howTo: Launch the ball, operate both flippers, and hit bumpers, lanes, and targets for points and multipliers.

name: Candy Match
description: Swap neighboring candies to make rows or columns of three.
controls: Tap one candy then an adjacent candy
objective: Reach the target score within the move limit.
howTo: Swap adjacent pieces. Only swaps that create a match are accepted; matched candies disappear and new ones fall in.

name: Robot Programmer
description: Build a command sequence that guides a robot to its goal.
controls: Tap command tiles • A run • B undo
objective: Reach the goal using the command limit.
howTo: Add move, turn-left, and turn-right commands to the program, then run it. Avoid walls and collect required batteries.
